text:
A delegation from the Kwara State chapter of Arewa 4 Asiwaju (A4A), led by State Coordinator, Malam Nurudeen Imam urged northerners to support President Tinubu’s continuity. The delegation joined key leaders and political stakeholders in Abuja for the official unveiling of the movement’s National Headquarters. They included members of the Kwara State Executive Committee, notably Malam Ibrahim Bashar, Director of Security Services, and Dr. Abubakar Bayo Ishola, Secretary of A4A in Kwara State. The National Headquarters was officially commissioned by Vice President Kashim Shettima, who highlighted the economic achievements of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s administration and called on northern stakeholders to mobilize support for the Tinubu-Shettima ticket ahead of the 2027 general elections. The event brought together A4A leaders, coordinators, and supporters from across the 19 northern states, providing a centralized operational base for the movement’s nationwide mobilization efforts. Speaking to journalists at the venue, Anas Galadima, urged northerners to turn out in large numbers to support President Tinubu’s continuity. He pointed to key developmental projects completed across the northern region, alongside ongoing efforts by the administration to strengthen security and boost local economies.
Galadima also rallied support for Kwara State, calling on voters to support Salihu Yakubu-Danladi (SYD) for Governor of Kwara State to sustain the All Progressives Congress (APC) development agenda across the state.
